description: This PHP source file defines the EmailSubscriptionAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing email subscriptions within an admin plugin of a Human Resource Management System. It includes methods for listing all email subscriptions, updating a specific subscription's enabled status, and relevant validation rules. The class uses OpenAPI annotations for documentation and integrates with various internal services and models.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionAPI
classes.description: API class for managing email subscription entities, providing endpoints for listing and updating email subscriptions in the system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles retrieving a list of all email subscriptions with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for creating new email subscriptions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for retrieving a single email subscription.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the enabled status of a specific email subscription identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for deleting email subscriptions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating an email subscription (not implemented).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single email subscription (not implemented).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an email subscription.
